implementation.source: Explicit Pharmaceutical/source/version binding, whole original UTF8/text and immutable hashes. Max8192 supporting roots/8MiB complete Source all-or-refuse. Independent pharmacist role-at-signature is recorded separately from Super technical publication; unknown professional status cannot execute. It is a recorded review, not verified professional licensure or independently authenticated official label.
implementation.output: Dedicated System/Task and closed64 literal field questions from15 fixed types with up to16 exact Unicode-codepoint spans each. Question and quote bounds preserve BOM/CRLF/emoji; partial extraction never proves label completeness, dosing appropriateness, patient suitability or prescribing authority. No prescription, product-master or clinical write.
implementation.task: Whole8MiB separate Source/Result Artifact plus three existing short rawJSON TEXT bodies each<=65535UTF8 bytes. Full raw6SHA and frozen System/Task/instructions, exact create/use/accept AuditPK, accepted lease and all22 Run terminal fields read back atomically. Individual usage remains nullable; unknown is never imputed as zero.
implementation.runtime: Current actor/token/source/professional signature/config/Provider/Prompt/quota checked before/after Chat or Responses completion; no SQL connection across model await. Fresh current authorization precedes private Task/Artifact TEXT. Short opaque Artifact lookup catches an old RR snapshot with a newly committed task; known generic controls stay generic.
implementation.frontend: Dedicated complete Source governance/Input/Assistant/Findings/Task API, strict same-Run Super trace and sticky native Parent/History markers. Missing/null top-level markers, uniqueDomain, selected_sources and residual source references cannot silently downgrade to generic. Real Pharmaceutical-row entry binds actual SKU and provides explicit Source/signature management; ordinary admin entry hidden. Role/session/username/source/close/KeepAlive changes clear private content and reject late results.
implementation.super_admin: Manages technical Source publication/revocation, independent professional review records, feature/Provider/Prompt configuration and explicitly chosen frozen read-only trace. Frozen Super audit does not grant an executable current Source.
